Description: SWE-bench Multilingual extends software-engineering patch generation beyond Python to multiple programming languages and ecosystems. Cognitive Functions:
L1: Language Comprehension (minor)
L2: Semantic Understanding & Context Recognition, Logical Reasoning, Planning, Working Memory
L3: Cognitive Flexibility
